# Affilia

> AI citation audits and GEO services for the affiliate industry. We get affiliate networks, tracking platforms, AI tools, and partnership SaaS recommended by ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini. Performance-priced — we get paid when you start being cited.

Affilia is the citation audit and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) agency for affiliate-industry vendors. Our customers are companies whose products are sold through affiliate channels: affiliate networks (Impact, PartnerStack, Awin, CJ), tracking platforms (Rewardful, FirstPromoter, Tapfiliate, Trackdesk), AI tools marketed to affiliates (Jasper, Surfer, AdCreative.ai), and attribution/link infrastructure (Pretty Links, Lasso, Dub.co, ClickMagick).

We engineer brand presence in the corpora that LLMs cite — Wikipedia, Reddit, G2/Capterra, YouTube, Substack, earned media — rather than chasing Google rankings. The result: when a marketer asks ChatGPT "what's the best [category]," our clients are in the answer.

## Key facts

- Less than 3% of affiliate-industry vendors have a dedicated AI citation strategy
- AI search converts at 14.2% vs Google's 2.8%
- Perplexity referrals convert at 11x organic search rates
- 800M weekly active ChatGPT users (Q1 2026)
- Google AI Overviews intercept 1 in 5 commercial queries (93% zero-click rate)

## Service tiers

- Starter: $5K/month + 10% performance kicker on attributed AI revenue lift
- Growth: $12K/month + 15% performance kicker
- Scale: $25K/month + 20% performance kicker

Every engagement begins with a free 30-minute citation audit benchmarking the client against three competitors across six LLMs.
